title: Why Ken Masters was sent away as a boy in Street Fighter
subject: ken
description:
Would you rather train with Ryu or with Ken? 👇

How a rich American kid became Ryu's rival and brother under Gouken. Light spoilers for the Street Fighter series.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Ken Masters was born rich, so his father sent him away.
His dad, an American hotel tycoon, shipped the spoiled boy to Japan to learn discipline.
His teacher was Gouken, a quiet master, and the only other student was a boy Gouken had raised, named Ryu.
Ryu trained for the path itself. Ken trained to prove he was more than his last name.
But here's the twist. The rivalry that should have split them made them brothers.
Ken became a U.S. champion, married Eliza and raised a son, yet every fight still answers one old truth:
